caption: The drawing features several intricately woven objects made primarily of brown and golden-brown materials, resembling plaited hair, displayed against a plain off-white background. There are multiple necklaces and bracelets, each composed of interlocking loops and latticed patterns, some wide and flat, others narrow and rounded. Most of the pieces are adorned with gray or blackish ribbon bows; the bows are placed at intervals where loops cross or at clasp-like junctions. One large cross is also present, made of the same woven material with a central black ribbon. The items are labeled with small, delicate handwritten notes in pencil identifying their styles or types. The composition is carefully arranged, with the pieces spaced to fill the rectangular area, creating a visually balanced layout. The drawing uses a limited color palette consisting mainly of shades of brown and gray, emphasizing the textures and construction of each piece.
title: Shaker Hair Wreath
